The kind is confined by `[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}` (`crates/core/src/claims.rs:43,89-95`). This excludes `..`, separators, absolute paths, backslashes, controls, whitespace, Unicode, shell metacharacters and percent-encoded traversal text.
